title: Amaana Halfinaa Maayo
intro: Ruuhu ina fotnoo yamiroore nde waawaa waɗde, ɗo nguurndam jibinaaɗo keso fawii e dow ŋoral. Ardii ɗum ko ƴoƴre Alla, yamiroore teskinnde ɗooftaa, sirlu tedduɗo waɗtaa e dow ŋoral, tan artiraa e laawol ngol anndaaka.
clues: Mi wuuri ko e les njiimaandi jom doole en, yamirnooɗo warde worɓe jibinɓe keso.
Ilmu Alla ari e am, yamiri mi yo mi waɗ feere tiiɗnde, ɓuuɓnde ɓernde.
Mi fawi cukalel am teddungel ngel e nder kees, mi fawi ngel dow maayo ɓuuɓngo.
Ɓernde am wonti meere, miɗo fotnoo feeñninde sirlu oo, kono Alla semmbinii pellital am.
Mi nelii neɗɗo ngam rewde laawol cukalel ngel haa les, nde tawnoo ɓuuɓol ngol ina nawra kees oo.
Cukalel ngel ko galle tippuɗo oo tawi ɗum, haa jooni, mi hawri e ɓiɗɗo am, mi wonti jom suudu am.

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: O waɗti ɓiyiiko e nder kees, o joɗɗini ɗum e dow maayo
O acci ɓiyiiko to damal juulirde
trial.answer: O waɗti ɓiyiiko e nder kees, o joɗɗini ɗum e dow maayo

location.label: Elemen keyɗo
options: Taabal taariindi e ñaamdu ummoraade asamaan

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: O hawri e ɓiyiiko, o ñammini ɗum
Ko jom doole en mbari mo
O wonti laamɗo debbo to leydi Misra
O eggii o fayi leydi ngoɗndi, o wuuri e eggude
outcome.answer: O hawri e ɓiyiiko, o ñammini ɗum

arabic: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ ۖ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِى وَلَا تَحْزَنِىٓ ۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers." (28:7)
